description:
FILED s525u (Opus, 2026-10-24) while shipping R1 of docs/runtime-review-s525.md.
PRE-EXISTING (main ef5df65a: the same answers).

s525u made a BOX's `nv-ok` perl's pNOK for the bitwise mode decision
(%p-bitwise-kind-of): a string in a box that was numified takes the NUMERIC
op.  A RAW value -- an array/hash ELEMENT (raw by default since the boxed-
aggregates flip), a foreach alias over a raw element or a constant, an @_
slot aliasing one, sort's $a/$b over raw elements -- has no box and so no
flag.  perl sets pIOK/pNOK on the ELEMENT SV when it is numified.

REPRO (scratch/s525u/probes/m1fp.pl, perl 5.40.3 vs PCL; hex of the result):
  { my @a = ("ab"); my $s = $a[0] + 0; print $a[0] | "  " }      perl "0"  PCL "ab"
  { my %h = (k => "ab"); my $s = $h{k} + 0; print $h{k} | "  " }  perl "0"  PCL "ab"
  for my $x ("ab") { my $s = $x + 0; print $x | "  " }            perl "0"  PCL "ab"
  sub f { my $s = $_[0] + 0; print $_[0] | "  " } f(my $x = "ab")  perl "0"  PCL "ab"
  my @s = sort { $a <=> $b } (my $x = "ab", 1); print $x | "  "   perl "0"  PCL "ab"

A NUMERIC-LOOKING raw string is answered right today BY ACCIDENT: the text
guess (`looks-like-number`) that stays for #1040's pragma reason sends it to
the numeric side, which is what perl does once it has been numified.

WHAT A FIX NEEDS: a place for the flag on a raw value.  Either the element
read that numifies writes the number back into the slot (perl's own
behaviour: the SV becomes PVIV with both halves -- but that changes what a
later STRING read of the slot answers unless the string half is kept, i.e. a
dualvar-shaped slot), or the slot is boxed on numification.  Both cost on the
hot element paths (the raw-elements design, docs/boxed-aggregates-design-s455.md,
exists to avoid exactly that).  Not attempted; size the cost first.  Low
real-code exposure: it needs a NON-numeric string that was used as a number
and is then a bitwise operand.

=== WIDENED AT THE MERGE (Fable, s526, 2026-10-24 14:5x): the ORDINARY LEXICAL IS A RAW VALUE TOO ===
Fable's merge probes (scratchpad p525u/p8-shapes.pl, perl -> base -> tree): `my $p = "abc"; my $pn = $p + 0; print $p | "  "` is "0" in perl and "abc" on the s525u tree -- at file level, in a bare block, closure-CAPTURED (`:captured t` is still a raw CL variable: CL closures share the binding), and as a sub parameter (`my $v = shift`).  The compiler emits an un-aliased `my` scalar as `(p-let (($x :scalar ...)))` = a RAW unboxed slot (ir-spec Â§2b.2a), so there is no box to carry nv-ok.  The box face s525u shipped is reached by: `our` / package variables (defcells), a lexical whose REFERENCE is taken (`\$t` -> `:box`), a lexical the compiler declines to make raw, dualvars (`$!`).
MEASUREMENT TRAP that hid this: s525u's probe file m1.pl declares `my $x` in TWENTY sibling blocks, and that spelling makes the compiler emit `p-my-=` on a BOX for every one of them -- so its row L (`{ my $x = "abc"; my $y = $x + 0; print $x | "   " }`) passes on the tree, while the SAME statement alone in a file prints "abc" (p9a-d.pl: with 2 or 3 spaces, with or without parens, in or out of a block -- all "abc").  Rule: probe a representation-dependent fix with each shape in ISOLATION as well as in a set.
So the exposure is NOT low: it is the common `my $s = <string>; ... $s + 0 ... $s | ...` shape.  The fix sketch above stands (a flag on the raw slot, or boxing on numification, cost measured first); the pragma emission of #1040 is the other half.
subject: DIVERGENCE (the raw-value face of #1040, pre-existing): a RAW value that has been used as a number keeps no flag, so a non-numeric-looking one stays on the bit-STRING side -- `my @a = ("ab"); $a[0] + 0; $a[0] | "  "` is "0" in perl, "ab" in PCL; also a hash element, a foreach alias of a constant, an @_ alias, sort's $a/$b -- AND the ordinary `my $x` itself, which the compiler emits as a RAW `:scalar` slot (Fable s526)
